propositions: The shared-tier lanes in _build-and-test.yml pass CLI --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread flags that permanently shadow ini changes carried in patchsets, preventing self-verification of budget fixes
Pytest-timeout precedence (CLI > env > ini) combined with trusted-main workflow execution means a patchset modifying pyproject.toml timeout config is not tested by its own Verified run
The CLI --timeout flags must be removed from both shared-tier lanes (default-suite and integration) to single-source the budget authority to pyproject.toml
Effective hang budgets remain unchanged after removal (both CLI and ini specify 300 s with thread method), moving only authority to the ini
The parity contract must be rewritten to assert the shared-tier lanes carry no --timeout/--timeout-method flags and that the ini provides the real guard
Eleven other CI pytest lanes retain their explicit calibrated --timeout flags, as they drive external services and may run outside the repo root where the ini is unavailable
